}}'''Zanica''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] who remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the [[White Tower Schism]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zanica}}  Her [[Ajah]] is not currently known, but she is not [[Blue Ajah]] because she is a loyalist, and also she is not [[Red Ajah]] as she has a [[Warder]].

She is also secretly part of the [[Black Ajah]].

== Activities ==
Zanica, along with [[Desala Nevanche]], [[Melare]], [[Arebis]] and three other Aes Sedai, were involved in [[Leane Sharif]]'s capture at [[Tar Valon#Northharbor|Northharbor]].

[[Egwene al'Vere]] has some lessons with her.

Zanica is listed as a member of the Black Ajah in [[Verin Mathwin]]'s book.
